title: Cauchy cube with 90 degree out-of-phase axial and shear stresses
description: Illustrative, normalized stress history. The prescribed components are σ_zz / σ_a = sin(ωt) and τ_zx / σ_a = τ_xz / σ_a = 0.6 sin(ωt + 90 degrees). All other components are zero. The values shown on the cube faces represent the instantaneous stress state at time t in the loading history. Arrows reverse direction at sign changes and vanish at zero. The cube is undeformed. Without animation, the figure shows ωt = 45 degrees.
convention: Subscripts identify the face-normal axis first and the traction direction second. Only the three visible positive faces are shown. The hidden opposite faces carry opposite traction vectors. Both curves and all arrows use a common stress scale. This illustration is not experimental data or a fatigue-life prediction.
note: Axial + shear loading. Shear amplitude / normal amplitude = 0.6.
